PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner
Todd Lemmis, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-57286  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-57287  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, November 20, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-57293  Recommendation to request City Council accept Exemption SE-25-142, finding the
  proposed Zoning Code Amendment and Local Coastal Program Amendment
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act pursuant to Section

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  15061(b)(3) (Common Sense Exemption), as it will not result directly or indirectly in
  significant environmental impacts; and

  Request that City Council approve a Zoning Code Amendment (ZCA25-001) and
  Local Coastal Program Amendment (LCPA25-001), and adopt the proposed
  findings related thereto, to introduce and establish new regulations for
  Microenterprise Home Kitchen Operations (MEHKO) within Title 21 (Zoning) of the
  Long Beach Municipal Code to support proposed changes to Title 5 (Regulation of
  Businesses, Trades and Professions) of the Long Beach Municipal Code.
  (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-57288  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record, conclude
  the public hearing, and consider a third-party appeal filed by Los Angeles
  Conservancy c/o Andrew Salimian (Case No. 2510-17 (APL25-006);

  Accept Categorical Exemption CE-24-145; and

  Deny the appeal (APL25-006) and uphold the decision of the Zoning Administrator
  to grant the approval of a Local Coastal Development Permit (Case No. 2401-15
  (LCDP24-006), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval
  thereto, to allow the demolition of an existing 2,911-square-foot, two-story single
  family dwelling and construction of a new 3,846-square-foot, two-story single family
  dwelling with an attached 600-square-foot garage, located on the first lot off the
  water at 5679 Corso Di Napoli in the R-1-S (Single-Family Residential, Small Lots)
  Zoning District. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
